name: Uozumi Shintaro
source:
Chairman of major developer Uozumi Real Estate.

At first glance, he appears to be a clean, large company, but he originally started out as a shady land speculator and his business style is ruthless when it comes to making a profit.

He likes money and women.

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonochikai/]the official site[/url]]
